title: Kamishiro Rui — I Can't Just Lose, Can I?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: I Can't Just Lose, Can I?（4★）
meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hi, Emu! Hi, you guys!
Welcome☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is it true that we get to see your guys' show today?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since we're back to doing our regular shows. We'd like to hear what you think and polish it up as much as we can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cool! I can't wait to see it!
It's gonna be so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You won't be disappointed!
So, let's head over to the stage!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Rui! Nene!
Emu seems a lot better now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We have you to thank for that, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I wouldn't have been able to come up with that on my own. Everyone's ideas led me to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin by getting the stage set up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'll run a sound and lighting check. Can you all handle the rest?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Watch as we travel across the seven seas!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for handling all that, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Still...
I haven't seen MEIKO or Luka at all today.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I thought they'd be at the stage, but...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui, hello!
Wait, is the show about to start?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, we're still setting everything up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
That means Luka can snooze for a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We should be fine as long as she wakes up when it starts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, now that Emu feels better, we've been able to get in some good practices. We have you and the others to thank for that, so we'd very much like you all to see it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I heard from Len that KAITO needed some help with something, which gave us the opportunity to ask you all about something that we'd been dealing with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have you and Luka to thank since you said that we were free to visit whenever we like.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a result, we discovered a wonderful way to help Emu. So, I greatly appreciate what you did for us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka...
Look at you, Grinning while being sound asleep...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, we have you to thank as well since you were nice enough to help KAITO with what he needed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, you're always going out of your way to help us, so it only seems fair to give back somehow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's okay, really.
I mean, after all, it's our job to understand how you're all feeling and support you however we can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well, I say that...
But it's not going to stop any of you, is it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't worry. Whenever any of you need help, we'll be there to give you all the support we can♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... If only I had a bed that could move on its own...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Luka, what are you talking about?!
Also, wake up already!
